title: Cyril's confession of the Word's nature
english: I have never been convicted of thinking anything contrary to what the truth approves, nor have I ever said that the divine nature of the Word is capable of suffering. And a little later: I know that the nature of God is incapable of suffering, unchangeable, and invariable, even in the nature of humanity, and that there is one Christ in both natures and from both natures.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 77; Ep. 53 Ad Xystum. PD.
